nom: Dermalogica Oil to Foam Total Cleanser

avis.texte: This cleanser is such a gem! I see it as a pre-cleanse and special cleansing gel hybrid that works really well on it's own or as a second step in a dual cleansing ritual. Great lather & Doesn't leave my skin feeling stripped!

I honestly thought maybe this was a new formula from the chunkier oil cleanser bottle. Thank god its not! Had to return it. Did absolutely nothing to my face. It felt like it just stayed on my face and didnt move. Super weird.

This didn't thoroughly clean my skin as advertised. I was looking for something that would truly be 1 step cleaning, without having to precleanse with micellar or cleaning balm. I use Bare minerals mineral powder foundation but after using the cleanser, I swiped with toner and cotton ball still picked up foundation that hadn't washed and rinsed off. I don't use eye makeup so can't attest to efficacy of dissolving eye makeup but can't imagine it would work well for that either. I got for half off but still don't think it's worth it. Save your money and try something else.

I love this cleanser. It actually feels like i have brand new skin every single time. I have very dry skin and it does not dry me out. I simplg cleanse and moisturize right after. Its amazing and get rid of all the gunk!
I really wanted to like it, but it doesn't remove eye makeup and therefore I can't trust it to wash the rest of my face appropriately. Too expensive to not perform as expected.

This cleaner fills the gap I didn't even know I had in my skincare routine. I have been double cleansing for a while. Down to the last few uses of my expensive 1st cleanser and couldn't find a sale. Enter Ulta's LYS event. I think, why not give this one a go? Best skincare decision yet! It's amazing! I have dry, sensitive skin and this is the first time in years that I didn't feel immediately compelled to moisturize. Yet, my skin is incredibly clean. Like, next level clean with none of the dry, tight, stripped feel. Instead, it actually imparts a healthy subtle glow of clean and my skin seems almost fortified from the experience. Did you know a cleanser could do that? I didn't. I finally know what clean, happy skin feels like! I now have one cleansing step. The elimination of the double cleanse step makes this cleanser well worth its cost by saving me time and money! Another win: only a couple or three drops create the most rich, lovely and nourishing foam so this bottke should last a good while. That didn't stop me from buying four more!

I got this on sale and really didn't think I would like it as much as I do. I was surprised that it cleanses so well but is not drying. I really like it. I would recommend it for all types of skin, although it might not be cleansing enough in the summer in the south for someone with super oily skin.

Ive struggled with cleansers for about ten years but this one has definitely got to be the best. I noticed a difference ij my skin a few days after continous use. I feel like it cleared up soem acne scars i had. I even had my dad try it fo some of his aging sun spots he had and he loved it as well. I tend to get dry skin easily especially during the winter so i use it every night with a moisturizer right after

This is my absolute favorite cleanser! I have very sensitive skin and this product does not irritate or leave my skin feeling stripped like some cleansers do. Please don't ever discontinue this product!
I thought this would be an alternative to 2-step cleansing but I feel the need to still use another cleanser after this. So I'm still at two steps. Won't repurchase.
My skin loves this, and it loves almost nothing. I find a little goes a longway. Would be 5 stars if th bottle didn't leak.

This is the best product I've ever used on my skin! I swear by it. My skin is extremely sensitive and very acne prone and it has been a life saver! The only thing i dont like about this product is that the bottle leasks. Its already an expensive product and i have wasted a lot just from the bottle leaking. However, i will keep buying bevause it is has been amazing on my skin. It would be a 5 star if it was not for the leaking bottle.

Removes my mascara and all face makeup AND cleans my face at the same time leaving the skin so smooth!! Would recommend to anyone who wants to get rid of a step in the skincare routine and add this one in since its two in one! 1000/10

I love Dermalogica skin care products, and after using other products to save money, came back to tIhe brand. I used to use the pre-cleanse followed by the special cleansing gel (or Cerave) but am now converted to this oil to foam cleanser. It's only one step, my skin feels fabulous and it's gentle enough to remove eye makeup. 10/10 Recommend!!!
Great to get off my sunscreen, less great for concealer/makeup by itself. But this works as a great, gentle wash for very sensitive areas AND removes my deodorant residue.
I found this to be gentle on my skin and remove most of my make up. I usually have to wash twice. I have eczema around my nose and this product does not irritate.

Ooooook. My search is OVER. This is a miracle cleanser. It is non-drying, sans alcohol like the special cleansing gel, (my previous go-to), and an all around winner. Make up remover? It does that. Cleanses? It does that AND leaves the skin supple- not stripped. All I can say is WOW. I am extremely picky and selective due to my sensitive skin. This is EVERYTHING.
This is a great product that removes makeup, it doesn't dry out my face. This is a new favorite product.
My new face wash!! This item is so good. It feels amazing on the skin. Cleans well and face feels moisturized and soft after the wash off.
I absolutely love this cleanser! It's truly an all-in-one cleanser. It removes make-up, cleanses and it doesn't dry your skin.

avis.titre: The Only Product To Clear My Skin.
avis.texte: Before using this, I was using a cleanser, a cleansing oil, an exfoliating serum, a moisturizer, and lots of pimple patches to clear my acne. After buying this, I just use it and a moisturizer. My skin never fewls stripped after use, and it has lasted me about three months! Would definitely recommend, i'm 16 years old and have had allergic reactions from many products.

I love Dermalogica, but they missed the mark on this one. I usually use the precleanse with the glycolic acid face wash and thought I would save a step by using this. It left a film on my face and needed to do a second wash anyway.

I have sensitive/combination skin & this literally broke me out SO BAD. I wouldnt even say i have acne prone skin & honestly .. it took some time to even start the crazy breakout. 2 weeks after consistent use and i started to develop red bumps on my forehead along with PAINFUL pimples UNDER MY SKIN, in area's i normally would NOT "break out" in. Only thing that cleared me up and brought my skin back to normal was getting a facial extraction along w/ holistic products provided by my esthitician.

I got a full size sample bottle a while back.. Its great at removing impurities and hyderating if you happen to have dry skin. I use this product every now and then but its just too oily for me to use daily. Discovered Boscia went out of business soo im looking for a new face cleanser and rechecking out ones I've tried previously.

avis.titre: No wonder why it's expensive - it works!
avis.texte: This is the best cleanser for removing makeup without drying your skin. I recieved a sample of this and came back to buy the full size because I loved it so much. I don't have to double cleanse or cleanse harshly, everything comes off. Ugh no wonder why its expensive

I am so grateful to the employee that reccomended this product as a "pre-cleanser." I have combination acne-prone skin and wanted to start pre-cleansing my skin to see if it would help my skin. I have seen so many improvements with my complexion and I love how clean my skin feels after I use this product. The price is so worth it because a little goes a long way. Forever re-purchasing!

I like the idea of this product but it just doesn't work. I expected the oil to remove my makeup and sunscreen fully, as other oil cleansers do. After washing my face with this product I felt I still needed another cleanser to remove the oily residue. Even after using both cleanser I could still see makeup/sunscreen in my pores. I used a toner afterwards and saw more makeup on the pad. Also, I cannot get the product to foam. I follow the instructions and the oil consistency changes but it doesn't really foam.
Smells really good. I love how it foams up and its perfect for my first cleanse to remove my sunscreen.

avis.titre: I will definitely purchase this product again!
avis.texte: I was skeptical of if this product would really work and remove ALL of my makeup… let's just say I'm sold on the product and I'll purchase again! 10/10 🤩

I like this as a quick cleanser and was hoping it would eliminate a 2 step cleansing. I don't feel like it completely cleanses all my make-up off. I do like the scent. It foams up nicely with just a small amount. It's nice for traveling if you don't want to pack all of your products.
My favorite end of the day cleanser. Works magic to remove all makeup, yet doesn't dry out my skin. Awesome product.

I bought this after it was recommended by my esthetician. I have combination dry and oily skin. This cleanser is perfect as it is both hydrating and cleansing at the same time. Some cleansers are too harsh causing my skin to over compensate and become oily. Not this one! It's light and smells amazing too. A light citrus scent. Plus I don't need to use a makeup remover first. Probably only recommend a makeup remover if you are wearing heavy eye makeup.
I really love this cleanser! I feel the ingredients make my sign feel clean and supple. It applies very evenly, and the level to which my skin is clean is perfect.

I got a sample package of this in a recent Ulta purchase and tried it that night and immediately went to purchase a full size bottle! Makes my skin SO soft and very clean! It definitely is on the pricy side for my taste but how it makes my skin feel completely worth it!! Plus how easy it takes my makeup off as well! Doesn't make my skin feel dry either. Highly recommend this!
Love this product been using a lot of the products for over a year
This cleanser does a good job cleansing your face, but is too harsh for eyes. After using it for less than a week, my eyes became very irritated and red. Had to discontinue use.

Great oil to foam cleanser that does not require a double cleanse! It easily removes my long wear foundation, mascara and eye makeup. Leaves my skin nice and clean but totally comfortable. It has a pleasant smell. I have many oil cleansers as they are my favourite way to cleanse, but this is my favourite as I don't have to double cleanse.
I received this cleanser as a gift and I absolutely love it! It made my face feel clean but also somewhat smooth and moisturized. I cannot wait to try more products from this brand.
Leaves your skin feeling clean and fresh. It removes the day's debris at night and prepares your face for moisturizer and makeup. I great one step process!
A little goes a long way with this product. Absolutely love how it removes makeup and my skin feels hydrated so much afterwards!!
I find the special cleansing gel from dermatological much more effective and less liquid.

This is a fabulous cleanser formula. It gets all of my makeup off without causing over drying of my skin. My skin feels hydrated and very clean after use. I use this as part of my daily routine without concern for overly drying my skin. It feels rich when first applied and lathers nicely.
I love this product, easy to use and having sensitive skin I haven't had a reaction

My favourite cleanser... I mix it with a few drops of water and massage it all over my face -- including over my eyes. Then I gently massage my lashes as well in order to help get my mascara off. Then I wash my face with water - use face pads to get the black colour from the mascara off my face and voila - my skin is all clean. I don't feel double-cleansing is needed with this product. It gets everything off - even make up. I rarely do double-cleanse.. but only when I really have a lot of make up on, which is rarely the case.
I have oily acne prone skin. This product made me have way more closed comedones ( made my skin bumpy). last a while, a little goes a long way. Maybe it's made for people with clear skin

I got is for the first time as an a free example. I do love it as my skin becomes so soft right after usage. I never loved oil cleansers till the time my cosmetologist told me it's perfect for my skin type and it is amazing when you use any scrubs. It helps to peel your old skin without any damage. It doesn't hurt my eyes. I love it so much. For the second time I got it as a small size compliment and I would definitely buy the full size soon!
I was surprised the difference in my skin texture after using the oil to foam cleanser. My skin felt so velvety. I love that if fulfills 2 cleansing products into one.
Love it! Gentle on my skin and it cleans without leaving my face dry. New favorite facial scrub!
This product has become my everyday fav! I like the texture and how it lathers. It easily removes my stubborn eye makeup. Rinses off and leaves your skin feeling very cleansed.
Very nice, it lathers into a light foam. My go to cleanser now.

The Oil to Foam Cleanser is a great product that combines 2 products in one. My sensitive skin was not very happy with it though. I did not get the results I had hoped for. After 2 uses I broke out. :confused: It feels great going on and cleans well. It leaves your skin hydrated and looks dewy and smooth. If my sensitive skin would have cooperated, it would have been my go to cleanser.

I am not one that uses make up remover and likes an easy skin care routine. This cleanser is your one stop shop! Removes my eye make up effortlessly and leaves my skin feeling clean but not dry. I am a huge fan.!

I recently decided to switch skin care regimens as my last one wasnt really doing anything for my skin. I then went into ulta and saw this new cleanser and tried it on my hand and my hand felt so smooth and soft so I got it. After a week of use I noticed that my pores are much better and my skin is so much smoother and this cleanser makes it so easy to take off my makeup. Definitely recommend

I have used Dermalogica products for 17 years. I love that this brand is evolving to a more botanical based product line and is always developing new products to meet the needs of my ever-changing skin care needs.

avis.titre: This cleanser made my skin bumpy.
avis.texte: I thought this was a great idea to combine the ingredients so it would remove makeup. It didn't work out as anticipated. The cleanser made my skin bumpy and didn't remove all of my makeup ( I don't wear heavy makeup). Will go back to pre-cleanse and special cleansing gel.
I love this product, it left ny face feeling so clean and quickly removed ny makeup
At first it's oily then once you rub it on your face and add water it gets foamy almost. I've seen a difference in my congestion already!
Been waiting for a cleanser like this that covers all the cleaning bases without all the oil of precleanse. LOVE IT:heart:️.
Love love love love love love :two_hearts: Beautiful cleanser
Great product to wash the grime and makeup of the day away without drying my skin. No harsh rubbing required either.

How did you do it!? This is the easiest cleanser on the market. Make-up remover and cleaner all in one. Thanks for helping hone down my routine. Every minute counts in my busy mom/pro esthetician life!
I've been on the hunt for something like this for years! I love the daily micro exfoliator but I wanted something gentle that actually removes makeup. This stuff is amazing! My skin is so soft now!

This has been the greatest cleanser I've ever used. It has done wonders for my oily/combination skin, leaving it feeling deeply cleaned and refreshed without stripping away moisture. And it spells delightful, which is a plus!

Just received my Oil to Foam Total Cleanser and absolutely love it! I have never been consistent with the double cleanse system. This product takes care of that for me. The end result is clean, smooth, glowing skin. Try it! It is an awesome product!

Again, Dermalogica has a winning combination of product! This saves time (& $$) by gently emulsifying the makeup/sunscreen/sweat & washing it away with the foam. This cleanser leaves the skin super clean without stripping natural oils.
Really nice cleanser. It removes even thick heavy sunscreen off face and neck. Leaves skin clean and soft. Doesn't sting eyes. And no fragrance is a plus!
This is super easy to use and does an excellent job of cleansing. I like how far a small amount goes too
I love this awesome smelling and wonderful cleaning product!!
Does a great job at getting makeup off. Feels great on my skin. I often double cleanse with it.

avis.titre: I was skeptical but it really works!
avis.texte: I work a lot and at the end of my day I hated taking off my makeup so I had high hopes this product. It did not disappoint. No scent, got my mascara off and left my skin clean but not dry. The product is on the pricy side but I find, after reading the instructions, you don't need to use a lot of product. I see the bottle lasting for a while.

I starting breaking out soon after using this cleanser. I gave it some time thinking i could be purging or my face was just reacting to a new product. My estitician looked up the ingredients and said there was way too many essential oils listed along with castor oil, both of which are bad for your face and will cause acne.

I have used the pre cleanse and special cleansing gel for years. I assumed this cleanser would replace them since it's a pre cleanse and face wash in one but that is not the case. I like that it is gentle and a little goes a long way but I noticed after a few weeks my skin started breaking out. I decided to use a toner after cleansing and noticed a lot of makeup was left behind. I could even see makeup still in my pores so I realized my skin wasn't getting thoroughly cleaned. I won't be repurchasing, for the price tag, I would expect an exceptional cleanser and this one is not.

First - use less than you think! I purchased this instead of my favorite Dermalogica oil pre-cleanse. This is not as good in my opinion. It's a great cleanser, but i will use it as a step in my daily double cleanse. Not a replacement for the pre-cleanse, but a nice product!

I really wanted to love this like I love other products from this line, but I am completely broken out after using this for s few days. It is pricey just to be out that money. As a poorly paid public school teacher I cannot afford to lose money on products.

This cleanser was gifted by Dermalogica. This cleanser gives my skin the deep clean that it truly needs without feeling stripped. It is super moisturizing and lathers very well. This is perfect for someone like me who has all the excuses in the world about taking the time to remove makeup before bed. This gets the job done and literally melts away my makeup. Will definitely be purchasing!

I love the concept of this cleanser! It's an oil to foam cleanser, so it helps break down any makeup and oils you have on throughout the day and when it comes time to rinsing, it lathers into a foam that helps remove the rest of your makeup off and washes your skin. I still recommend doing a double cleanse or using a micellar water after to really make sure you removed everything. However, this does an amazing job at removing your makeup and cleansing the skin! Gifted by Dermalogica.

This is a pretty great cleanser. It works very well and has been a great one step product to remove makeup and leave my skin feeling clean and fresh. I like that this is so gentle and though I need to use another remover for some makeup products, it works well as a second cleanser or even just on its own. I was gifted by Dermalogica.

This oil to foam cleanser is a game changer. It was so satisfying to see the makeup come off with ease after the first use. My skin felt a bit oily after. I thought it was from product that wasn't washed off, but the cleanser does the same thing even when I don't have makeup on. I don't mind it because I have dry and sensitive skin. I thought it would break me out, but my skin is flawless. This cleanser was gifted by dermalogica.

I received this product complimentary from Dermalogica! I absolutely love this cleanser! I wear heavy makeup and it literally melted it right off my face! I also used their pre cleanse product and they paired great together!

avis.titre: Best cleanser I've tried so far
avis.texte: I have never tried an oil to foam cleanser. My first time using and I enjoyed how it felt on my skin. Once it starts foaming you can see all the makeup just lifting up. My skin felt smooth and refreshed without leaving it feeling dry or tight. Has a very light scent and I'm overall pleased with this product. Gifted by dermalogica

This cleanser does an amazing job at removing my makeup and any oils. It's transforms from oil to foam. It makes my skin feel super clean, and healthy looking. I like to dampen face, massage the cleanser over my face and eyes to dissolve surface oil and dirt. Then I wet my hands and continue massaging to create a foam and then rinse.

No need to double cleanse with this cleanser. This cleanser really removes all my makeup and leaves my skin feeling clean and hydrated!!! Remember to dampen your skin beforehand so that the oil can glide smoothly to pick up the makeup. I love the citrus scent as well. Gifted by Dermalogica.

Gifted by dermalogica. This cleanser cleans my face so well after wearing makeup all day and I love how it foams up when mixed with water. It leaves my skin soft, refresh and clean without stripping my skin dry. Love it! 10/10

Gifted by Dermalogica. I love a foaming cleanser! My face feels squeaky clean after using this product and I feel fresh. It is very effective for removing makeup from my pores and giving me a clean face.

This is such a great cleanser! A little goes a really long way. It creates a luxurious lather and does an excellent job at breaking down makeup and sunscreen. I always double cleanse and this works great as a first and second cleanser without stripping my skin. I received this complimentary from Dermalogica but all thoughts are my own!

This cleanser is such a generous size, and so amazing for sensitive skin! It does a wonderful job removing oily sunscreen, and make up without being overly drying. I even use this to remove my eye make up. Gifted by dermalogica

I am impressed by the clean ingredients because I feel comfortable using this on my face daily. It works very well to remove makeup and oils from the day. It was gifted by Dermalogica and I will be using it often!
Very nice cleansing product. Gentle on my sensitive skin. I'm happy with my purchase.

This product is so unique. I've literally never tried anything like it. It's very effective in breaking down and removing my makeup and sunscreen, without stripping my skin. After using this product my skin feels clean and soft. Gifted by Dermalogica

Absolutely love this! It's gentle but at the same time removes all of my makeup. There's no intense smell which I greatly appreciate too. This was gifted by Dermalogica in exchange for my honest review.

I really love using this cleanser to take off my makeup and spf at the end of the day. I like the consistency and it suds up very nice. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and smooth!! And takes off all the residue. Gifted by dermalogica

I love Dermalogica products and this cleanser has become my favorite. I use it quite a lot and it has worked great on my skin. It melts away makeup and sunscreen as well as cleanse the skin. It leaves skin feel soft. Complimentary from Dermalogica

Dermalogica gifted me this oil to foam total cleanser. It has been one of my trusted brands for skin care and this cleanser is absolutely perfect. It does not have any strong fragrance and does a really great job of through cleansing .

I wasn't sure what to expect from this - I've tried other "oil to foam" cleansers that do nothing in the first "phase"- but this one has a nice thick consistency you can rub easily around a damp face to remove sunscreen & makeup. Then, add more water and it foams up and washes really clean. It has no scent and no residue. It does not remove waterproof makeup by itself, but I use a small makeup eraser cloth on my eyes before washing the rest of my face off and that works fine. I really don't need a second cleanse with this, so that's a huge bonus! It also removes well with a wet cloth. It's a HUGE bottle that will last me a year! Gifted by dermalogica for my review.

I have experimented with various face wash products, both from this vendor and others, but this new wash truly stands out for its impressive performance. As someone with combination skin, I am pleased to say that this product effectively caters to my skin type. Great job!

*gifted by Dermalogica* this is a great product for removing makeup and sunscreen. I'm usually not a huge fan of oil cleansers but I love that this one turns to a foam and does not leave behind residue.

Excellent cleanser! Love how it leaves my skin feeling ultra clean. It removes all my make and products with no weird residue. I only use a tiny bit so this is well worth the price. I highly recommend this product gifted by dermalogica.

I love this cleanser, always loved Dermalogica products, a little goes a long way, it doesn't dry my skin after using it like most cleansers (I have dry skin), I recommend it 100% for dry and normal skin. Complimentary from Dermalogica

I enjoyed using this cleanser as a first step cleanser to remove any SPF and makeup. Feels nice and is effective at cleansing my skin. I prefer a second cleanser to follow. This was kindly gifted by Dermalogica. Oh, and I love the packaging.

I swear by double cleansing and this is the perfect addition to my routine! Best part is you can use this twice to achieve a great double cleanse or use this after their pre cleanse oil. I love how gentle this formula is while still breaking up and removing all my makeup. This leaves my skin feeling super clean without stripping it or leaving me dry. Love Dermalogica, gifted by Dermalogica.

Gifted by Dermalogica! Love that this product is a makeup remover and face cleanser in one! My skin feels so clean after every use! Does not dry out my skin! Highly recommend especially on heavy makeup days!

I loveeee hope this cleanse doubles up and removes my makeup and cleans my face! I like that it gets to a good consistency for cleaning after adding water! I would definitely recommend to others I will be purchasing another. Gifted by dermalogica

I loved this cleanser! It was sufficient in taking off my makeup with one wash, and it felt nice on my skin- not oily at all! I was gifted this product complimentary from Dermalogica, but I would spend my own money on it.

Dermalogica never disappoints, no gimmicks, just does what it says it does. This cleanser is great though I did have to rub my lashes twice to remove waterproof mascara. It shortens the time it takes me to cleanse, love i. Gifted by Dermalogica

One of my favorite new cleansers! So easy on the skin and feels so good! I love that it's an oil base and then turns into foam as you go on, it makes taking off your makeup so much faster and really gives you a deep clean! Complimentary from Dermalogica

this was complimentary from dermatologica but i will be buying more! The oil helps me get all my makeup off, and then the foam allows me to cleanse my face after. the texture is great and it left my skin feeling fresh and hydrated. it was not sticky which i love!

I have loved every dermalogica product so far and I was almost confident that I was going to love this cleanser too! I can pick anything with my eyes closed and know that it will work wonders and this didn't disappoint either. It's gel based and foams up easily! I don't feel like my skin has been stripped of everything after washing yet a super clean feel too. Complimentary from Dermalogica.

Gifted by Dermalogica. I like using the cleanser. It was unscented and pretty gentle on my skin. It didn't make my skin too oily or too dry, so I would purchase it again. And I would recommend this to my friends.

I love how effective the Oil to Foam Total Cleanser that I received complimentary from Dermalogica removes my spf and makeup! It melts it all down and develops a lush lather when I add a bit of warm water. I am surprised at how well this performs and doesn't require a second cleanse.

New favorite cleanser! It works really well without me feeling the need to double cleanse. It doesn't leave my skin feeling dry and my products are received well after using it. I am a fan of Dermalogica products and this one fits right in. Gifted by Dermalogica

Dermalogica gifted me the best cleanser! Usually make up removers don't remove your make up but this cleanser does it effectively! The texture is foam and soft. The scent is not powerful and the value size is good enough to last a long time!

I loved this oil to foam total cleanser from dermalogica. It was gifted by dermalogica in exchange for my honest review. I've been using it to remove my makeup and it stacked up pretty well. I applied to a damp face and the oil turns to this creamy, foamy texture. I should mention the oil is pretty lightweight. Instead of us hint a second cleaner I applied this one twice to ensure it removed most of my makeup. Only a little bit of my eyeliner and mascara is left behind. I'd purchase this cleaner for sure.

This cleanser is amazing! I struggle with hormonal acne and I'm currently trying to get it under control and have completely started from scratch with my skincare. This cleanser has become my new favorite at night to remove my sunscreen and makeup. It works so well and doesn't dry out my skin at all. I've noticed a huge difference even after using this only a week! Will definitely keep using!! This was gifted by Dermalogica
